objective: Replace nested model-owned non-fact clauses with one flat record per semantic atom, while retaining the already validated V3 fact layers.
causal_claim_under_test: The remaining clause failure is chiefly a response-topology and granularity burden. A flat atomic contract can preserve every valid V1 semantic item and its observed surface status, after which a deterministic local compiler can reconstruct clause groups without semantic guessing.

scope.facts_policy: Retain V3 raw, normalized, and derived fact layers byte-for-byte; this version changes only the non-fact clause contract.

fields.surface_item: exact source substring or null when no exact surface is observed

prohibitions: nested clauses or nested item arrays
multiple semantic atoms in one record
category, level, or relation inference during compilation
fact normalization or derivation inside the clause contract

deterministic_grouping_compiler.order_policy: Preserve first-seen group order and atom order; role determines items versus examples.
deterministic_grouping_compiler.source_policy: source_text and every non-null surface_item must be exact substrings of the supplied JD; null surfaces stay unmapped.
forbidden_runtime_inputs: company, title, URL, or source origin
forbidden_repairs: missing category, level, or relation backfill

requirements: Every frozen input hash matches before execution.
Model call count and network call count are both zero.
All outputs use exclusive creation and no V1-V3 file changes.
Every emitted atom validates against the frozen flat schema.
Every source_text is an exact JD substring.
Every non-null surface_item is an exact source_text substring.
All 59 unmapped primary surfaces remain null and are not guessed.

G2-flat-group-round-trip.requirement: After flattening and grouping, category, level, relation, source_text, group_name, allow_other, qualifier, items, and examples exactly match every source-valid frozen V1 clause in order.

G4-surface-accounting.requirement: Surface status and values match the frozen V3 projection exactly; unmapped values remain null.

G5-invalid-nested-v3-fails-closed.requirement: The invalid nested V3 response is classified nonrecoverable for clause compilation; no category, source_text, level, or relation may be guessed or inherited from fixture data.

requirements: Default parser and canonicalizer hashes remain frozen.
No v4 runtime module imports model clients, networking, or the canonicalizer.
No runtime branch reads case ids, job metadata, gold, or fixture paths.
Existing model-first V3 tests pass unchanged.

evaluation_protocol.failure_policy: Keep failed raw and report; diagnose offline and preregister a new version without editing or rerunning v4.

post_gate_protocol.on_pass: Keep v4 opt-in and connect it to a future model request only under a new preregistration; do not start canonicalizer work yet.
post_gate_protocol.on_fail: Retain the V1 clause path and the V3 facts-only result.
